completion_promises.criterion_text: SignInScreen shows a loading state while signIn() is in flight, with the sign-in control disabled
completion_promises.evidence: Converted SignInScreen from StatelessWidget to StatefulWidget with _SignInState enum tracking idle/loading/cancelled/failed states. During loading state, CircularProgressIndicator is displayed above the sign-in button, and the guard in _signIn() prevents concurrent calls.

completion_promises.criterion_text: On SignInFailed the screen shows a failure state with a manual 'Try again' affordance (no automatic retry)
completion_promises.evidence: SignInFailed exception is caught in _signIn() and _signInAs() methods, transitioning to _SignInState.failed. The UI displays an error icon, error message, and a 'Try again' button that calls _signIn() again when pressed. No automatic retry is implemented.

completion_promises.criterion_text: On SignInCancelled the screen returns signed-out and shows that sign-in was cancelled
completion_promises.evidence: SignInCancelled exception is caught and transitions to _SignInState.cancelled. The UI displays 'Sign-in was cancelled' message and returns to idle state with sign-in button available. User remains signed out.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A discovery-unavailable sign-in renders the failure state, not the cancel state — the two are never conflated
completion_promises.evidence: Discovery-unavailable is thrown as SignInFailed (not SignInCancelled) by the adapter. The UI catches these exceptions separately and renders distinct states: cancelled shows 'Sign-in was cancelled', while failed shows error icon and 'Try again' button. Test 'discovery-unavailable renders failure state, not cancel' verifies this distinction.

completion_promises.criterion_text: While loading, a second tap starts no second flow (UI guard; invokes signIn() once)
completion_promises.evidence: Guard implemented at top of _signIn() method: 'if (_state == _SignInState.loading) return;'. Test 'double-tap during loading invokes signIn only once' verifies that tapping twice during loading calls identity.signIn() exactly once by checking signInCallCount.

completion_promises.criterion_text: On success the screen pushReplacementes to HomeScreen (behaviour unchanged)
completion_promises.evidence: Success flow unchanged: after successful signIn(), _toHome() is called which performs Navigator.pushReplacement to HomeScreen with identity, sessionApi, and voiceApi. Test 'on success navigates to HomeScreen' verifies HomeScreen is found after successful sign-in.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Widget tests drive a fake IdentityProvider producing cancel / failure / success outcomes — no browser, no network
completion_promises.evidence: Created FakeIdentityForTesting class that implements IdentityProvider with configurable behavior (shouldCancel, shouldFail). Factories provided: cancels(), failsDiscovery(), succeeds(). All tests use this fake with no browser or network dependencies. 8 comprehensive widget tests cover all state transitions.

completion_promises.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
completion_promises.evidence: Ran 'flutter analyze' after implementation. Fixed dangling library doc comment warning by adding 'library;' directive. Final analyze result: 'No issues found!' All files pass lint checks with zero errors.
